description: This file contains unit tests for the TalkAudioPlayer class, focusing on its playback behavior, including handling of end-of-playback, failure, and multiple play calls. It also includes utility functions for creating test audio data and managing timeouts.

classes.name: TalkAudioPlayerTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying the behavior of TalkAudioPlayer, including scenarios such as stopping playback, handling multiple play requests, and ensuring non-hanging playback.

methods.name: `play does not hang when playback ends or fails`
methods.description: Test that playback does not hang when playback concludes normally or with failure.

methods.name: `play does not hang when play is called twice`
methods.description: Test that multiple calls to play do not cause the player to hang.

methods.name: withTimeout
methods.description: A utility function that adds a timeout to asynchronous work, throwing TimeoutError if the work does not complete in time.

methods.name: makeWav16Mono
methods.description: Generates a WAV format Data object with specified sample rate and number of samples, with silent audio samples included.
